answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the grove of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
